newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen up Wednesday, overall trend flat.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen up Wednesday, overall trend flat.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to rebound on Wednesday after two days of falls and stay in their general flat-to-down trend before the large public offering of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz starting on Monday.

Analysts said a central bank deputy head's Tuesday statement that Poland faced a gaping current account deficit and a Czech-style financial crisis in 1998 if it failed to balance next year's budget represented a longer-term threat.
They said the National Investment Fund NIF index should rebound on Wednesday after its recent slump.
Elpo transfers to the parallel market from the bourse's third floor on Wednesday, leaving the latter vacant.
